description: Das Megaloceros took one look at the square-jawed two-door and asked where everyone else was supposed to sit. A second row of doors, a roof that keeps going, and still a bed behind it long enough for the gear nobody admits to packing. Built for crews who measure a trip in days and a road in theory.

real.description: No crew-cab U 1300 L was built. The nearest real reference is the U 1550 L/37 crew cab: 3.70 m wheelbase, 5.56 m overall, 1.01 m front overhang, a 2.70 m body starting 70 mm behind the cab, and a 15.8 m turning circle on 12.5R20 tyres.
real.basis: Fictional: this model never came as a crew cab. The two-door's front and running gear with a crew cab, on the 3.70 m wheelbase of the U 1550 L/37 crew-cab drawing.
